title: Cokernels of quasi-coherent modules are quasi-coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\varphi:M\to N$ a morphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $M$ and $N$ quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. The categorical cokernel of $\varphi$ in $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] is quasi-coherent.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01ID; Section 01LA, items (3)-(5). Local source read at /home/ubuntu/c1-stacks-review/schemes.tex, lines 1435-1455 and 4717-4744.

proof.text: Restrict to an affine cover. Restriction preserves the cokernel. The affine counit identifies M and N with tilde modules compatibly with φ. Tilde preserves the module cokernel by its left adjunction, so the sheaf cokernel is a tilde module on each affine open. Its local presentations prove quasi-coherence.
